svg.title: Cart lifecycle
svg.desc: empty, then calculating after a package is added (cart.updated, cart.added, then cart.calculating), then priced when the prices arrive (cart.calculated). A page that opens with a saved cart starts at calculating. Pricing that fails sends sdk.error and moves to unpriced; the next change prices again. A change sends cart.updated, then cart.removed and cart.added for the packages it removed or added, then cart.calculating; while calculating, no second cart.calculating. Removing the last package, or clearing the cart, empties it (cart.updated, then cart.removed). A frozen cart refuses changes without events.

text.tspan: cart.removed, cart.added: after the change’s cart.updated, only for packages it removed or added
While calculating, a change sends no second cart.calculating; only the latest prices are used
A new shipping method: shipping.selected once the cart is priced with it (after cart.calculated)
A frozen cart, while an order is placed, refuses every change and sends nothing

tspan.style: fill: var(--color-rose-500, #e11d48); font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: → unpriced; the summary keeps its earlier totals
